admission.justification: The obligation is realized in five production modules - the assessment itself, the selection that carries the requirement owner's coordination root, the outgoing caller, the line-range diff's object store and the mounted record view - and two registered cases, one parametrised across three locator kinds and one across both owner arrangements, fail without it.

applicability: Every link of a record read through the mounted knowledge_read view record, or through the dashboard's record route, at the code tree that read captured.
conditions: The link names an anchor, a route, a requirement or a record.
exclusions: A read with no code tree: every anchor and route is unverifiable with that reason.
A target kind no reader assesses: still unverifiable, named as such.

evidence: r5-evidence/focused-final.log and r5-evidence/focused-reviewer-tests.log (6 passed in 21.36s); the two registered cases named here assert anchor, route and requirement-owner states and the mounted/dashboard equality

statement: Record-view links assess full anchors and route targets at the captured code tree and carry the requirement owner outcome, exact refusal, archival flag and latest approved version; the mounted and dashboard record routes agree.
